title: Glowing Toad in Apocalyptic Rain
description: A large, pale pink toad-like creature with glowing yellow eyes, golden cracks, and purple spots sits in the foreground on wet, muddy ground. In the background, a dystopian landscape shows burning fires, rising smoke, streetlights, and rain falling under a pink and blue twilight sky, with an open book lying in a puddle nearby.
prompt: A large pale pink toad creature with glowing yellow eyes, golden glowing cracks across its body, purple spots, and frilly pink gills sits in the foreground on wet muddy ground with puddles during rainfall. Dystopian landscape in the background with fires burning, black smoke rising, old streetlights glowing, under a pink and blue twilight sky. An open illustrated book lies in a puddle in the foreground. Surreal eerie atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
